about: Report a reproducible problem in the local demonstration

## Reproduction
List the commands or UI actions and the synthetic record IDs involved.

## Expected and actual behavior
Include HTTP status codes or sanitized error text, without tokens or private data.

## Environment
Python version, operating system, browser and whether you used Docker.

## Verification
Which unit or smoke checks fail? If relevant, attach the smallest synthetic request.
